mapper.select: SELECT * FROM todo WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY done ASC, importance DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM todo WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND importance >= 3 ORDER BY done ASC, importance DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo (user_id, title, content, description, importance, repeat_type, repeat_config, repeat_end_type, repeat_end_value, repeat_count, due_date, done, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{description}, #{importance}, #{repeatType}, #{repeatConfig}, #{repeatEndType}, #{repeatEndValue}, #{repeatCount}, #{dueDate}, #{done}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE todo SET done = #{done}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
